# Agents

People and software credited in the [PKM vocabulary](../vocab/). These are metadata
resources, not vocabulary terms, so they live in their own hash namespace —
`https://w3id.org/pkm/agents#Doug-Warren` rather than under `/vocab/`, where they
would dereference as if they were concepts.

Local names keep their hyphens on purpose: `Claude-AI` is the software agent,
`ClaudeAI` is the vocabulary concept, and they are not the same thing.

## Agents
